summary: Validated the pure backend refactor (server.py -> server.py + core.py + models.py). Full pytest suite executed; the 4 refactor-tracked test files pass 71/71 — identical to pre-refactor baseline. All required endpoints behave the same: auth login, /api/auth/me (fresh JWT), /api/content GET+PUT, /api/admin/notify-requests, /api/admin/analytics, /api/admin/audit, /api/subscriptions (bundleDiscountPct), reviews/faqs CRUD, change-password (iat invalidation), and login rate-limiter. Admin password remains omar512@@OoD at end of run.

minor.issue: Pre-existing flaky assertion `len(items) == 9`. The app default is now 10 sections (or another test in the same file PUTs 10 and doesn't restore). Test passes in isolation, fails when run after sibling tests. NOT a refactor regression.

test_auth_security.py rate-limit tests can flake if backend is not restarted between full runs because the rate-limit window persists in-memory; restarting backend (or waiting cooldown) restores 71/71.

action_items: (Optional, pre-existing) Fix tests/backend_test.py::TestSections::test_get_sections_default_or_persisted — either bump the expected count to match current default OR add cleanup to a sibling test that mutates sections.
(Optional) Consider adding an auto-reset of in-memory rate-limit state at test session start so consecutive full pytest runs don't need a backend restart.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean: routes/startup in server.py (~939 lines), shared infra in core.py (~163 lines, includes JWT iat-invalidation, login rate-limit helpers, audit-log helper, password hashing), schemas in models.py (~122 lines). Separation of concerns is sound.

core.py login rate-limiter is in-memory (per-process). This is fine for single-process supervisor setup but would break under multi-worker / horizontal scaling — flag for future-prod hardening (move to Mongo/Redis-backed counters).
JWT iat-based invalidation after password change works correctly (verified via test_reviews_faqs_password.py::TestChangePassword and audit checks).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — fixed stale REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL fallback (was pointing to web-polish-21.preview.emergentagent.com which returns 404; now points to dukkankka-shop.preview.emergentagent.com). Note: pytest uses env var when set; fallback only used if env var absent.

success_rate.backend: 100% (71/71 on the 4 refactor-tracked files); 109/110 across the full suite (1 pre-existing flake in legacy backend_test.py)
